extractedSignals: Want skills that do more than generate text? Claude can send emails, create issues, post to Slack, and take actions across 1000+ apps.
The connect-apps plugin lets Claude perform real actions - send emails, create issues, post to Slack.
It handles auth and connects to 500+ apps using Composio under the hood.
If you receive the email, Claude is now connected to 500+ apps.
Claude Skills are reusable instruction packages that teach an AI agent how to handle a specific class of tasks.
Each skill is a folder containing a SKILL.md file with YAML frontmatter (name, description) and Markdown instructions, optionally bundled with scripts, references, and assets.
At session start, the agent sees only each skill's name and description — roughly 100 tokens per skill.
